entities.name: İsmail Hakkı Bey
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: İsmail Hakkı Bey (1865–1927) was a composer and musician from the Ottoman Empire. He is also known for composing many of today's popular mehter marches, such as Ceddin Deden.
